name: repovibe
description: Local-first Chrome MV3 GitHub theme customization extension

scripts.check: node --check shared/core.js && node --check shared/theme-review.js && node --check content.js && node --check popup.js && node --check studio.js && node --check scripts/verify-package.js && node --check tests/live/live-helpers.js && node --check tests/live/github.live.js && node --check tests/live/scene.live.js && node --check background.js && node --check shared/wallpaper-store.js && node --check scripts/wallpapers/generate.js && node --check scripts/wallpapers/render3d.js && node --check scripts/wallpapers/build-catalog.js && node --check scripts/wallpapers/import.js && node --check shared/wallpaper-catalog.js
scripts.package: rm -f RepoVibe-Extension.zip && zip -r -X RepoVibe-Extension.zip manifest.json shared content.js background.js wallpapers popup.html popup.js studio.html studio.js ui.css icons README.md
scripts.wallpapers: node scripts/wallpapers/generate.js && node scripts/wallpapers/render3d.js && node scripts/wallpapers/build-catalog.js
